prompt: transform this video into a photorealistic 3D scene

rubric.c: The HTML opens in Chrome and the scene renders, with no errors or blank screen
rubric.mc: The pagecapture renders cleanly throughout, supporting the author's claim that it loads without errors in Chromium.

rubric.c: The scene runs at 30 fps or more on a standard laptop
rubric.mc: Real-time GPU performance was not measured; only slow software-rendered playback was tested, so a laptop GPU benchmark is needed.

rubric.c: The flyover starts playing on load; pause freezes the camera and everything in the scene; play resumes from the same frame
rubric.mc: This rests on the author's automated test claim, which verified play-on-load, pausing at frame 160, and resuming from the same frame.

rubric.c: The result is a 3D scene drawn live in the browser (geometry seen through a moving camera), not a video file or a flat image sequence played back
rubric.mc: WebGL renders depth-displaced 3D meshes through a moving camera to synthesize intermediate frames, as evidenced by geometric parallax and mesh-edge warping in the close-ups.

rubric.c: Nothing is added that the video does not contain: no text, logos or overlays on the scene, no extra objects (birds, clouds, people, vehicles), and no interaction beyond the playback controls
rubric.mc: The rendered view contains no added overlays or extra objects, and per the technical notes, interaction is limited to playback controls with no free camera.

rubric.c: Dense green broadleaf forest covers the near hills and fills the lower half of the opening view, as in the video
rubric.mc: Dense broadleaf forest fills the lower half and near hills at 0.0s, matching the reference video.

rubric.c: Layered mountain ridges span the full width of the background, with the same skyline profile as the video (highest ridge left of centre, lower ridges stepping down to the right)
rubric.mc: The background mountain ridges span the full width with the exact skyline profile of the video across all stills.

rubric.c: A brown tilled field lies in a clearing among the trees and comes to dominate the lower-middle of the view in the second half of the clip
rubric.mc: The brown tilled field opens up among the trees and dominates the lower-middle view from 9.7s to 17.4s.

rubric.mc: Rows of white/silver greenhouse roofs and the long red-roofed building sit at the lower right by 19.3s, matching the video.

rubric.c: Colours and time of day match the video: strong daytime sun, warm saturated greens in the foreground, cooler blue-green in the distance
rubric.mc: Daytime lighting, warm foreground greens, and cooler distant tones closely match the reference video.

rubric.mc: The scene immediately reads as an aerial flyover of forested hills and valley farmland.

rubric.mc: Slopes and valleys show convincing 3D relief and parallax during the flyover rather than reading as a flat plane.

rubric.c: The forest canopy reads as individual tree crowns of varied size and height, not a smooth carpet or uniform blobs
rubric.mc: Individual tree crowns of varied height and size are clearly defined in the 10.4s canopy close-up and throughout the clip.

rubric.c: The opening view matches the video's first frame: horizon about a third of the way down, sky above, ridges across the middle, forest below
rubric.mc: The 0.0s frame matches the video's composition with the horizon a third of the way down, ridges mid-frame, and forest below.

rubric.c: Light comes from the upper left as in the video: the sky is brightest there and tree crowns are lit on that side with shade on the other

rubric.c: Distant ridges are paler and bluer than the near hills (atmospheric haze)
rubric.mc: Distant mountain ridges show the same pale blue atmospheric haze as the reference video.

rubric.c: Foliage reads as leaves: matte, mottled light and dark greens, not flat colour or plastic
rubric.mc: The forest canopy retains mottled, matte leaf detail rather than looking flat or plastic.

rubric.mc: No repeating texture tiles or cloned trees appear anywhere in the forest or fields.
